summary: Saint Louis County, Minnesota tower listed as gone. A 1934 Library of Congress photograph is credited, but no build date or present-day description was found.

facts.status_note: The FFLA list marks it gone. No source we found describes the site today.

events.note: Date of a Library of Congress Historic American Buildings Survey photograph credited by Central US Lookouts; not a build date

evidence.supports: listed as Wynn Lake, Saint Louis County, marked gone, with coordinates
evidence.quote: Wynn Lake Saint Louis 47.57281 -92.31066 Tower Gone

evidence.supports: the Central US Lookouts entry heading spells the name Wynne Lake
the same page's navigation list reads Wynn Lake
land reference 59N-16W-25; land listed as State
1934 photograph credit and caption location near Duluth on Rice Lake Road
evidence.quote: March 26, 1934 - P.M. Olsen Photo, Library of Congress, Historic American Buildings Survey (near Duluth on Rice Lake Road)

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Name: brief and FFLA say 'Wynn Lake'; Central US Lookouts heading says 'Wynne Lake' (its nav list says 'Wynn Lake'). Location conflict unresolved: the HABS caption says 'near Duluth on Rice Lake Road', while the FFLA coordinates (47.57281, -92.31066) and the Central township reference (59N-16W-25) point elsewhere. The Library of Congress HABS record for the photograph was not opened and could settle the name and place. No build date, builder, staffing, fire history or present-day description found in two web searches and the caches. Story is short because the evidence is thin.
